user.title: NextFloor
user.description: Adds a sidebar page where you draw your home and see it in 3D.

announce.name: Announcement
announce.description: Speaks a message in rooms of the plan, each through its own speaker, and shows and speaks it on every open NextFloor screen.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Rooms by name, room id or area id. Empty: every room with a speaker (rooms in their quiet time are left out).

floor.name: Floor
floor.description: Only the rooms of this floor (name or id).

on_screens.name: On the screens
on_screens.description: Show and speak it on the open NextFloor screens.

screens.name: Only these screens
screens.description: Names of NextFloor screens (set on each screen). Empty: every screen.

tts_entity.name: Text-to-speech
tts_entity.description: Instead of the one chosen in the plan, or the first one.

no_rooms.message: No room of the plan matches the rooms given.

no_tts.message: No speaker could say it: set up a text-to-speech entity in Home Assistant.
